settings.title: K5 vehicle integration
settings.description: Climate, front seats, Vehicle app, Comfort, media, volume and radio shortcut. Restart required.

settings.title: Suppress stock volume popup
settings.description: Hide OEM volume presentation only while connected CarPlay is foreground and CPUL volume feedback is ready. Restart recommended.

settings.title: Parked AirPlay video
settings.description: Allow video only during an active CarPlay session with fresh Park feedback. Restart required.

settings.title: AirPlay video audio (experimental)
settings.description: Try local video sound while parked. Fall back to picture-only if audio output fails. Restart required.

settings.title: CarPlay Ultra
settings.description: Enable theme identity, session start, virtual display, DBX and extended Ultra capabilities. Restart required.

settings.title: Ultra themes and UI synchronization
settings.description: Enable layout, palette and wallpaper synchronization when CarPlay Ultra is enabled. Restart required.
